text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I came to watch Fuji Kiseki's dance 
practice, since she's performing in a new 
outfit, but—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, when you gaze at me with such 
earnest eyes, even I feel like I might get 
nervous.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even while saying that, Fuji Kiseki 
finished her dance with brilliant, 
flawless steps. Her performance was truly 
magnificent, leaving me utterly 
captivated.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Yeah, this is great. This outfit 
is so light, it lifts my spirits every 
time I move!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
From your perspective, how does it look? 
It might be a slightly different image 
from how I usually am.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It may be different from her usual look, 
but the elegant color and delicate 
ornaments suit Fuji Kiseki perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, thank you! Hearing you say it with 
such conviction makes designing it so 
worth it!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Trainer-san. Shall we move 
somewhere else? Other girls will probably 
come by if we stay here."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I ask where we are going, Fuji Kiseki 
simply laughs, saying, "It's a secret," 
and walks ahead. Following behind her—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, just as I thought. There's nobody 
here at this hour.
choice_data_list: Why are you in the gym?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
How about a song? If you would take my 
hand—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
In your ears, in your heart... The 
greatest song will surely be playing.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...With an unforgettable sound, you know?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Alright, let's get started!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Led by Fuji Kiseki, we enjoyed a brief 
dance.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You're doing great, Trainer! Come on, just 
go with the flow more!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki looks at me with a smile. 
Rather than music, this feels more like a 
drum beating inside my heart...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, at the same time—it's fun. It 
feels as though Fuji Kiseki is 
transforming even my clumsy steps into a 
splendid dance.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that was fun. Shall we take a short 
break and try it once more?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Are you wondering, 'Why so suddenly?' 
Actually, I've wanted to invite you for a 
while now.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Are you familiar with 'Ligne Droite'? It 
is a dance party held to celebrate the new 
year."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Lots of pony-chans dressed up like 
colorful flowers, and then they dance!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Of course! —Now then.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I might dance with the little ponies, but 
getting the chance to dance with you, 
Trainer, doesn't come around very often, 
does it?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I want everyone to have fun. Not just my 
little pony, but Trainer and everyone else 
too!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Not just for "someone"... I want to reach 
the many people who are beyond my grasp as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Female Patient
text_block_list.text:
Even someone like me can still make 
someone happy, can't she...?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...It's not easy, but if even just one 
person who takes my outstretched hand can 
smile, then that's enough."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I can't help but feel that someone else 
out there will reach out their hand to the 
ones they want to see smile, too.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...I poured that very wish of mine into 
this outfit, you see."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Like a star shining in the sky. So that 
the roses may continue to bloom in the 
light and warmth illuminated by that star.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Wishing that no matter what path you 
walk, you will always be able to find the 
light."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No matter how small the light may be... If 
it shines upon me, I will be able to find 
it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Isn't that just like a "miracle"?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I felt as though that "miracle" Fuji 
Kiseki spoke of had just been bestowed 
upon me, too. And so—
choice_data_list:
At least one person definitely walked away 
with a smile.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... That's not quite right, Trainer. 
It's not just one person, but the two of 
us.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...To ensure this smile never fades, would 
you dance with me once more?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Taking each other's hands, they share a 
smile. Fuji Kiseki's expression, softer 
now than before, was like a faintly 
shining star itself."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No matter how steep the place you stand... 
so that smiles may bloom.
choice_data_list: You can do it, Fuji Kiseki!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you! Hearing you say that gives 
me the strength of a hundred people!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"For that reason, we've got to put our all 
into the stage performance as well, not 
just the race."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Would you care to join me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I take her outstretched hand with 
exaggerated flair, saying, "With 
pleasure."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bursting into laughter, Fuji Kiseki began 
stepping far more lightly than before.
